children: A Redirection Crystal is filled with Tibanna Gas and has a small blasting tube. Snipers and assassins use them to seemingly bank blaster shots, allowing the shooter to hide in one location while making a shot appear to come from another position. When struck by blaster fire, the gas inside the crystal explodes, directing the shot through the blast tube at the established angle. Only skilled snipers and assassins use Redirection Crystals because of the sheer difficulty in making a successful strike. Redirection Crystals are sometimes used in conjunction with the
, taking advantage of the weapon's invisible blaster shot to confuse the enemy.
